pois.name: Trim
pois.description: Trim is a small field shelter, built in drystone technique, without any mortar. Farmers used it is a shelter in bad weather but also for the surveillance of fields and vineyards before harvesting. The roots of some of them date back to the Stone Age.

pois.name: Leporini Restaurant
pois.description: Restaurant located in Hvar, Croatia, known for its Mediterranean and Croatian cuisine made with local ingredients, offering a warm atmosphere in a historic setting.

pois.name: Passarola Restaurant
pois.description: Experience Passarola in the heart of Hvar. A charming rooftop restaurant offering a modern take on Dalmatian classics.
